messages:
maria_cs: Heads up — Crestline is asking to split their renewal: 60% prepaid now, 40% prorated midterm. CFO also wants KMS listed in the contract + a vendor code on the PO. Legal says the SOW needs a tiny update. Any blockers on our side?

alex_se: Thanks, Maria. Is the prepaid portion going to be applied as a credit on their account? We need to confirm billing flow for midterm true-up.

jordan_cfo: @maria_cs correct — we'll sign if KMS language and vendor code are present. Vendor code they'll need on their AP side is VC-CRST-2026. Can we get an invoice for 60% first?

sophie_legal: Quick read: KMS clause ok but need to reference our standard key-handling appendix. I'll patch the SOW and send a redline. ETA 2 business days.

maria_cs: Perfect. @sophie_legal pls include the data residency note we discussed last quarter. Crestline is EU-based.

sophie_legal: noted — will add residency + export control line.

alex_se: On the billing side, we can emit a partial invoice. Two ask items: (1) do they want invoice net30 or upfront payment? (2) which billing entity — US or EU?

jordan_cfo: They'll pay by wire for the prepaid piece. Net30 for the remaining prorate. Billing entity should be EU (Crestline EU SARL).

sam_onboard: Heads-up for enablement: Crestline requested two kickoff sessions post-sign. We'll schedule 3x 60m slots and add a recorded overview for their SREs. Want that reserved after closing.

maria_cs: @sam_onboard yes please, plan for the week after signature. I'll coordinate dates once we have signature ETA.

bot-docusign: DocuSign envelope created by maria_cs: https://docusign.example/ENVELOPE/abc123 — status: Created.

alex_se: Two operational tasks for infra: (a) add vendor code to PO template: PO.vendor_code = "VC-CRST-2026" (b) billing metadata: {"prepaid_percent":60, "prorate_percent":40, "billing_entity":"EU"} — will open internal PR.

sophie_legal: Uploaded SOW redline: https://files.example/sow-crestline-redline.docx — highlighted KMS appendix + residency line.

jordan_cfo: Reviewing now. If SOW looks good we'll route signing tonight.

maria_cs: Risk note: If legal redline takes >72h or CFO delays wire, the onboarding timeline slips. Marking as medium risk.

alex_se: Acknowledged. I'll set up a billing alert to flag missing wire after 5 business days.

sam_onboard: Added provisional calendar invites (tentative) for enablement. Will convert to confirmed after signature.

jordan_cfo: All good from my side. Wire scheduled upon receipt of invoice + docusign.

maria_cs: Great — thanks all. I'll post final once doc is signed and funds hit. :thumbsup:
